annotations.title: Seedream 5 Pro image generation and editing

description: ByteDance's flagship Seedream 5 Pro: sharp 1K or 2K images from text or up to 10 reference images. Compared with other image tools: premium. Price: from $0.062 per image, charged only on success. Price depends on size: 1K $0.062, 2K $0.123 (default 2K). One call = one image.

image_input.description: Reference or source image URLs (https), optional

size.description: Output resolution; sets the price. Default 2K
